what_worked: The 197 AI companies figure is correctly pulled from the dataset.
fix_next: This is a startup pitch, not a data story—rebuild entirely around dataset analysis with charts, findings, and limitations.
verdict: Startup pitch deck, not a data story; dataset is essentially unused.
factual_error_detail: Slide 2: 'B2B Resilience — Enterprise models produce stronger recurring revenue' is unsupported; dataset median multiples (B2B 2.35x vs B2C 2.30x) show negligible difference, and mean favors B2C (8.44x vs 7.97x). Presented as a clear finding without evidence.

evidence.insight: Only one dataset fact used (197 AI companies). No charts, no deeper analysis of revenue, categories, platforms, missingness, or any other dimension. Eight of ten slides are a product pitch for an agriculture startup with zero analytical content.
evidence.narrative: Coherent as an investor pitch (problem → solution → moat → ask), but this is the wrong genre. The dataset appears on slide 2 and is immediately abandoned. No analytical arc, no synthesis, no landing tied to data.
evidence.framing: No research question, no dataset description, no scope, no definitions, no mention of missingness or sample limitations. A cold reader cannot tell what dataset was analyzed or what the analytical objective was.
evidence.accuracy: 197 AI companies is correct. 'B2B Resilience' claim is misleading given near-identical medians and B2C-favoring means. 'Top startups remove repetitive tasks first' is unverifiable from the dataset. No denominators, no charts to audit.
evidence.visual: Every slide uses AI-generated illustrations that are purely decorative. Slide 6 dashboard mockup contains garbled nonsensical text. Slide 9 illustration has misspelled labels ('AUTOCONNIZATION FRRMING'). No data visualizations exist anywhere in the deck. Gamma template is consistent but repetitive.
evidence.ai_slop: Pervasive: every slide has AI-generated comic art with garbled text (slides 6, 7, 9). Generic consulting buzzwords throughout ('data moat', 'platform economics', 'full-stack autonomy'). Entire deck reads as a Gamma-generated pitch template with near-zero customization to the assigned dataset.

change_reason: Lowered insight from 1.5 to 1.0 (single correct number does not merit 1.5 when no analysis exists) and visual from 2.5 to 2.0 (garbled AI-generated text on multiple slides and zero data charts warrant lower score). Other scores unchanged; preliminary was already appropriately low.
